# Land PR #128 safe subset via Gerrit: json-repair 0.63.0 + genai-prices 0.1.2 + botocore 1.43.69; mcp 2.0 deferred to 732b (4th re-proposal)

## Context / Problem

GitHub is a read-only mirror: dependabot PRs never merge there; content is re-applied
locally and landed via Gerrit, then the PR is closed. PR #128 (branch
`dependabot/uv/uv-lock-bfcc8af838`) proposes 4 uv-lock updates:

* `mcp` `1.29.0` -> `2.0.0` (MAJOR) — the FOURTH re-proposal (PRs #124/#125/#127),
  rejected each time under ticket 1dfd-…: mcp 2.0 renames `FastMCP` -> `MCPServer`,
  replaces transport+`ClientSession`+`initialize()` with `Client`, splits types into
  `mcp-types`, and diverts stdout while serving — all breaking for `mcp_server.py` +
  `gen_mcp_reference.py`. Migration is epic `732b-51df-acf2-477b`; the pyproject
  ceiling stays `mcp>=1.28.1,<2` (core L22 floor via `[mcp]` extra L82 + agents L215).
  NEW urgency fact (recorded on 732b as part of this work): v2.0.0 is now the STABLE
  release and v1.x is in maintenance mode (security fixes only), so `<2` is
  time-bounded — but that changes the epic's priority, not this ticket's scope.
* `json-repair` `0.62.0` -> `0.63.0` (minor) — SAFE. Usage surface:
  `src/rebar/llm/structured.py` calls `repair_json(cand, return_objects=True[, schema=…])`
  (L387-408); 0.63.0 adds None->null repair + fixes a `TrueBlue` mis-repair — both
  strictly improve the tolerant-parse ladder; the called API is unchanged. pyproject
  floor `json-repair>=0.61` (L132) already admits it: LOCK-ONLY.
* `genai-prices` `0.1.1` -> `0.1.2` (patch) — SAFE. Pricing-data-only additions (new
  model prices); consumed via optional lazy import in `usage_report.py`/`usage_log.py`
  (`Usage` + `calc_price`, unchanged). pyproject has no pin (L150): LOCK-ONLY.
* `botocore` `1.43.68` -> `1.43.69` (patch) — SAFE. Routine service-model update;
  lazy imports only (`bedrock_model.py`, `structured.py`, `remote_cert.py`). Floor
  `botocore>=1.43.0` (L291) admits it; boto3 1.43.68's botocore range (`<1.44`)
  accepts 1.43.69, so boto3 itself need not move: LOCK-ONLY.

This ticket lands the three safe bumps only. No new mcp migration ticket is filed —
epic 732b already owns it (per the #125/#127 precedent, tickets
carnivoral-consistent-lhasaapso and reclinable-ammonitic-hound / change 1812).

## Approach

In a fresh worktree branched from `origin/main` (`../deps-128`, venv on PATH):

1. NO pyproject.toml edit — verify with `git diff` that all three bumps are admitted
   by existing constraints (floors listed above; exact pins exist for none of them).
2. `uv lock --upgrade-package json-repair --upgrade-package genai-prices
   --upgrade-package botocore` — the lock is regenerated by uv, never hand-edited
   (CI gates on `uv lock --check`); then `uv sync --locked --extra dev --extra agents`
   so gates run against the bumped versions.
3. Verify the lock moved exactly the three intended packages to the PR's versions
   (0.63.0 / 0.1.2 / 1.43.69) and `mcp` stayed 1.29.0; `git diff uv.lock` must show
   no other version churn beyond uv's transitive bookkeeping for these three.
4. Gates: `make lint`, `make typecheck`, `uv lock --check`, and targeted tests for
   each usage surface: `pytest tests/unit/test_structured.py
   tests/unit/test_silent_success.py tests/unit/test_usage_log.py
   tests/unit/test_usage_log_pricing_qualified_2ca9.py` (json-repair + genai-prices
   consumers) plus `tests/unit/test_llm_capabilities.py` if present (botocore lazy
   import). Full `pytest tests/unit` is CI's job (host has pre-existing env git
   failures documented on dc89-cd11-acd6-4e61); CI Verified +1 is the authoritative
   full-suite gate.
5. Commit (subject <=50 chars, body wrapped at 72) with trailer
   `rebar-ticket: <this ticket's full canonical id>` + DCO `-s`;
   `git push gerrit HEAD:refs/for/main`. Leave the ticket in_progress for the bots;
   the change is submitted only after LLM-Review +1 AND Verified +1.
6. Comment on PR #128 (mcp rejected again per 732b, citing #124/#125/#127; safe
   subset landing via the new Gerrit change); comment the v2-stable/v1-maintenance
   urgency fact on epic 732b. Do NOT close the PR.

7. SCOPE ADDITION (operator-approved 2026-08-15): stop the recurring mcp 2.0
   re-proposals at the intake source. In .github/dependabot.yml's uv block, add
   an ignore rule: dependency-name "mcp", update-types
   ["version-update:semver-major"] — scoped to semver-major ONLY so 1.x
   patch/security bumps still flow and security alerts stay on. Append a
   one-line rationale to the header comment block: mcp major pinned out per
   epic 732b-51df-acf2-477b (fastmcp import removal); remove the ignore when
   the migration epic lands. Same commit as the safe-subset bump (same
   intake-noise lane).

## STOP / defer rule (explicit fallback done-state)

If ANY of the three bumps fails its targeted tests or lint/typecheck in step 4:
drop ONLY that package from the bump (re-run `uv lock --upgrade-package …` with the
remaining packages from a clean `git checkout uv.lock`), record the failure evidence
as a ticket comment, and land the remaining safe packages. The fallback done-state is
AC2b: the ticket closes legitimately with a PARTIAL subset landed, provided every
dropped package has a recorded-on-ticket failure reason. If ALL three fail, no lock change is pushed, but the dependabot.yml ignore
rule (step 7 / AC7) still lands — as a standalone change carrying only
.github/dependabot.yml — so the done-state is that standalone change merged
plus the recorded failure evidence; the ticket then closes on AC2b's
evidence path with zero lock bumps landed and AC7 satisfied.

## Out of scope

* mcp 2.0 migration (epic 732b) — the ceiling `mcp>=1.28.1,<2` is untouched.
* boto3 version bump — not in PR #128 and not required by botocore 1.43.69.
* Any src/rebar code change — nothing in the three deltas requires one.
* `.github/complexity-baseline.json` — never touched by a deps change.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] AC1: `uv.lock` on merged main records json-repair 0.63.0, genai-prices 0.1.2,
  botocore 1.43.69 (or a documented AC2b subset), with mcp still 1.29.0 and
  pyproject.toml unchanged; `uv lock --check` exits 0.
- [x] AC2: targeted usage-surface tests pass against the bumped versions
  (test_structured.py, test_silent_success.py, test_usage_log.py,
  test_usage_log_pricing_qualified_2ca9.py), and `make lint` + `make typecheck`
  exit 0.
- [x] AC2b (fallback path): every package dropped under the STOP rule has a ticket
  comment recording the concrete failure evidence and the re-lock excluding it; the
  landed subset satisfies AC1 for the packages it retains. (Vacuously satisfied when
  all three land.)
- [x] AC3: the change lands through Gerrit with a `rebar-ticket:` trailer for this
  ticket's full canonical id + DCO sign-off, after LLM-Review +1 AND Verified +1.
- [x] AC4: PR #128 carries a comment citing epic 732b + prior PRs #124/#125/#127 for
  the mcp rejection and pointing at the Gerrit change; the PR is left open.
- [x] AC5: epic 732b-51df-acf2-477b carries a comment recording that mcp v2.0.0 is
  the stable release and v1.x is maintenance-mode (security fixes only), i.e. the
  `<2` ceiling is now time-bounded.
- [x] AC6: this ticket records a relates_to link to dc89-cd11-acd6-4e61
  (reclinable-ammonitic-hound, the #127 precedent).
- [x] AC7: .github/dependabot.yml's uv block carries the mcp semver-major
  ignore rule (patch/minor still flow; security alerts unaffected) and the
  header comment records the 732b rationale + the removal trigger.
